dry_run.description: Print the summary and inline comments to the job log instead of posting them.

findings.description: The number of blocking and should-fix findings.

summary_url.description: The link to the summary comment. Empty on a dry run.

missing_id_token.message: The workflow has no `permissions: id-token: write`, so the action can't sign in to the Axon Shaft API.

api_unreachable.message: The action couldn't reach the Axon Shaft API, or the API took over 30 seconds to answer.

api_error.message: The Axon Shaft API failed, or its answer couldn't be used: a setting the action can't run with, or an error page from something in front of the API.

review_timed_out.message: The review, reply or task ran past the time limit set on the dashboard.

review_invalid_reply.message: The model's reply didn't match the review, reply or task format twice, so nothing was posted.

review_failed.message: The review, reply or task stopped for another reason, such as an Agent SDK error or the turn limit.

claude_binary_unverified.message: The Claude Code binary the action downloads from npm didn't match the sha512 this release records, or the release records none for the runner's platform, so it wasn't run.

push_failed.message: A task couldn't push its commit: Push mode, a fork's branch or the default branch ruled it out, the change touched `.github/`, or GitHub refused the push.

cancelled.message: The workflow was cancelled before the review finished. Its check runs end as cancelled, and the summary comment shows this card in place of "Reviewing".

nothing_to_fix.message: A bare `/fix` had nothing to fix: the last review has no open findings, or there's no review yet.

self_hosted_unsupported.message: A task ran on a self-hosted runner. Tasks run only on GitHub-hosted runners, so no session ran.

credentials_in_checkout.message: A task's checkout kept a token in `.git/config`, so no session ran. Set `persist-credentials: false` on `actions/checkout`.

sandbox_unavailable.message: A task couldn't start its sandbox on this runner, so no session ran.

fork_pull_request.message: A fork's pull request ran the workflow on `pull_request`, where GitHub gives it no OIDC token. Run the workflow on `pull_request_target` to review it.

not_a_pull_request.message: `/review`, `/ask`, `/fix` and `/axonshaft` work on a pull request, and this comment was on an issue.

no_write_access.message: The commenter has no write access to the repo. Only people with write access can start a run.
